title: A COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY ON EVALUATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL APPLICATIONS IN THE MEDICAL INDUSTRY

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing clinical vignettes, diagnostic suggestions, and treatment plans to identify stereotypes and performance disparities across racial demographics.
Analyzing clinical vignettes, diagnostic suggestions, and treatment plans to identify stereotypes and performance disparities across gender demographics.
